_comment: The pinned Projects UI artifact: url + sha256 + source commit. TODAY the artifact is built LOCALLY from an UNPUBLISHED commit of the UI source (source_commit_published=false) and lives in this repository (local_path), so builds and tests are offline and reproducible; no release of redevops-projects has been published for it, so `url` is empty and this record is NOT a source offer (decisions pins-04, pins-10 and D-LIC-12 stay OPEN; packaging/ui-bundle-source.json carries the same provenance). The source commit MERGES the public release v0.2.0 (Today-first views: Today, capture, batch triage, notifications, routing, deployment-inspection and social-intelligence cards) into the local accessibility series (UIA-01..12) and adds the mission drill-down views (Summary, Tasks, Evidence with Inspect, Timeline, Graph, World State, EXPLAIN, Replay). The Sample chip and every sample-versus-recorded decision come from what the RUNNING SERVER reports (GET /api/ui-config), not from a build flag: this one artifact serves a sample deployment and a runtime-backed one. When the server says runtime but the provider-backed pages (Missions list, Overview, Today) are still the sample projection, the top bar shows a "Partly sample" chip with a keyboard-reachable explanation, decided from the same report. `previous_pin` is the artifact this one replaces (the previous local build, whose Sample chip was a build flag; its own previous_pin chain goes back through the accessibility series to the public v0.2.0), which stays in the repository: going back is a lock edit. scripts/fetch_projects_ui.py verifies the sha256 before anything is extracted, whichever source it reads. The mission views also flag, in words and a glyph with the cites of the events, a step whose outcome is unknown, a late (stale) result and a compensation that did not complete cleanly, show the mission state in plain words (the raw state kept), and list independent read-backs as evidence with the verifier kind as recorded. Keyboard focus is visible on every focusable element from one shared :focus-visible ring (a --focus token, a system colour in forced-colors mode). Connecting, proposing and removing a source never fail silently: every refusal and failure of Connect & scan, Looks right and Remove is said in the page's own fixed sentences, keyed by the server's refusal code (the server's own message text is never shown), with the folder named as plain text; a folder registered in this session has a Remove button with an in-page question.

merged_public_release.note: public release of redevops-projects, merged into the source commit; not an ancestor of the accessibility series base

recipe.environment: env -i with PATH, throwaway HOME and TMPDIR, LANG and an isolated npm cache; VITE_PROJECTS_API=/ is the only build variable passed; built from a clean `git archive` of source_commit
recipe.pack: scripts/make_projects_ui_artifact.py DIST packaging/ui-artifacts/projects-ui-root-ea9e53e5.tgz (sorted members, mtime 2020-01-01Z, uid/gid 0, gzip mtime 0; the neutral hero.jpg of this repository replaces the UI repository's public/hero.jpg)
recipe.reproduced: index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS were built three times from a clean `git archive` of source_commit, each in its own throwaway HOME, TMPDIR and npm cache under env -i (node v24.22.2, npm 11.19.1, npm ci), on 2026-11-07 with identical sha256 (and identical to the development build); three consecutive packs give an identical archive. The archive bytes also depend on the zlib in use; the member hashes above are the portable invariant, the archive sha256 is what is pinned.

previous_pin.note: the same views before connecting, proposing and removing a source said anything when refused: a refused Connect & scan or Looks right rejected inside the page and showed nothing (the form stayed as typed, no message), and a folder registered in a session had no Remove button. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

the same views before the keyboard-focus fix: the top-bar 'Ask Sidekick' input had an inline `outline: none` and no focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7; found by the native accessibility harness, rows A11Y-FOCUS and A11Y-FOCUS-FORCED), and a focused control in a sideways-scrolling table could have its ring cut at 320 px. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

the same views with the 'Partly sample' chip, before the drill-down flags for an uncertain step, a late (stale) result and a compensation that did not complete cleanly, the plain-words mission state, and the read-back evidence rows. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

the same views and the same data-source report, with a Sample chip that was either on (sample) or off (runtime) and so said nothing about provider-backed pages that are still sample in a runtime deployment. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

Today-first views + accessibility series (UIA-01..12) + the read-only mission drill-down, with the Sample chip and every sample-versus-recorded decision taken from a BUILD FLAG (VITE_PROJECTS_SAMPLE_DATA, default on): one artifact could not serve a runtime-backed deployment without a second build. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

the accessibility series (UIA-01..12) on the old public base 5114b560 only: it does NOT contain the Today-first views and has one shared body for every mission tab. Kept in the repository so that reverting is a lock edit.

public release asset fetched by origin/main; Today-first UI (Today, capture, batch triage, notifications, routing, deployment-inspection and social-intelligence cards). The accessibility series (UIA-01..12) is NOT in it and the Today-first views are NOT in the current artifact.
